newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian stocks seen tilting at upside again.
newsitem.headline: Australian stocks seen tilting at upside again.

text.p: *Stocks seen staying on upside with plenty of buyer interest remaining. "The market is functioning like it is through liquidity," said Stuart Smith of Henderson Charlton Jones.
*Wall Street stocks roared higher, surging in the final hour
after the Federal Reserve left interest rates unchanged.
*ADRs: News Corp 19-7/16 (+3/16), BHP 30 (+1/4), WMC 25-9/16 (-3/16), National Australia Bank 73-1/8 (+1-1/4)
*Gold price was weaker. On LME, zinc prices stormed higher amid speculative buying but trend in the rest of the complex were mixed. Copper little changed, aluminium, nickel just up.
